name: Green & Clean Nairobi RAG Chatbot – Charts & Sensitization

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $input.first().json;
const today = d.nowISO || new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
const historyText = (d.history || []).map(t => 'User: ' + t.user + '\nAssistant: ' + t.assistant).join('\n');

// ================= CATALOG FOR BOTH SHEETS =================
const CATALOG = [
  "NUMERIC METRICS (sum/avg/rank/trend/compare):",
  "  staff_deployed (number of staff deployed for sensitization/cleanup activities).",
  "  attendees (number of people who attended sensitization/cleanup activities).",
  "  trees_planted (total trees planted - only in Greening Initiative sheet).",
  "  reports = count of activities/records (use for 'how many activities' or 'how many reports').",
  "",
  "TEXT-FREQUENCY METRICS (use operation 'breakdown', groupBy null -> ranks most-mentioned items):",
  "  resources_lacking (what resources/items teams request most).",
  "  key_messages (main messages shared during sensitization).",
  "  partners (organizations involved in activities).",
  "  activity_category (type of activity: Cleanup Exercises, Public Sensitization, Public Baraza, etc.).",
  "  tree_type (type of trees planted - only in Greening Initiative sheet).",
  "",
  "DIMENSIONS (groupBy / filter / breakdown):",
  "  subcounty (Mathare, Kasarani, Embakasi North, Ruaraka, Westlands, etc.).",
  "  ward (Kiamaiko, Mabatini, Hospital, Dandora, etc.).",
  "  location (specific road/place).",
  "  date (a single day), week, month.",
  "  activity_type (Cleanup Exercises, Community Sensitizations, Public Baraza, etc.).",
  "",
  "SHEETS AVAILABLE:",
  "  'Greening Initiative' - main sheet with tree planting, staff, resources, cleanup activities.",
  "  'Sensitization Programme' - specific sheet for public sensitization data.",
  "",
  "SHEET SELECTION RULES:",
  "  - If user mentions 'public sensitization', 'sensitization activities', 'awareness', 'sensitize' -> use 'Sensitization Programme'",
  "  - If user mentions 'tree', 'planting', 'greening', 'cleanup', 'staff', 'resources' -> use 'Greening Initiative'",
  "  - If user doesn't specify, default to 'Greening Initiative'"
].join('\n');

const EXAMPLES = [
  // ===== Greening Initiative Sheet Examples =====
  // Tree planting queries
  '"trees planted in Westlands" -> {"type":"aggregation","operation":"sum","metric":"trees_planted","groupBy":"subcounty","filters":[{"field":"subcounty","value":"Westlands"}],"mathRequired":true,"sheet":"Greening Initiative"}',
  '"trees planted in Kayole South ward" -> {"type":"aggregation","operation":"sum","metric":"trees_planted","groupBy":"ward","filters":[{"field":"ward","value":"Kayole South"}],"mathRequired":true,"sheet":"Greening Initiative"}',
  '"which subcounty planted the most trees" -> {"type":"aggregation","operation":"rank","metric":"trees_planted","groupBy":"subcounty","order":"desc","limit":1,"mathRequired":true,"sheet":"Greening Initiative"}',
  '"total trees planted in Kasarani" -> {"type":"aggregation","operation":"sum","metric":"trees_planted","groupBy":"subcounty","filters":[{"field":"subcounty","value":"Kasarani"}],"mathRequired":true,"sheet":"Greening Initiative"}',
  '"breakdown of trees by type" -> {"type":"distribution","operation":"breakdown","metric":"trees_planted","groupBy":"tree_type","mathRequired":true,"sheet":"Greening Initiative"}',
  
  // Staff and deployment queries (Greening Initiative)
  '"how many staff deployed in Mathare" -> {"type":"aggregation","operation":"sum","metric":"staff_deployed","groupBy":"subcounty","filters":[{"field":"subcounty","value":"Mathare"}],"mathRequired":true,"sheet":"Greening Initiative"}',
  '"total staff deployed in Kasarani" -> {"type":"aggregation","operation":"sum","metric":"staff_deployed","groupBy":"subcounty","filters":[{"field":"subcounty","value":"Kasarani"}],"mathRequired":true,"sheet":"Greening Initiative"}',
  '"staff deployed in Westlands for cleanup" -> {"type":"aggregation","operation":"sum","metric":"staff_deployed","groupBy":"subcounty","filters":[{"field":"subcounty","value":"Westlands"},{"field":"activity_type","value":"Cleanup Exercises"}],"mathRequired":true,"sheet":"Greening Initiative"}',
  
  // Attendee queries (Greening Initiative)
  '"how many people attended sensitization in Mathare" -> {"type":"aggregation","operation":"sum","metric":"attendees","groupBy":"subcounty","filters":[{"field":"subcounty","value":"Mathare"},{"field":"activity_type","value":"Community Sensitizations"}],"mathRequired":true,"sheet":"Greening Initiative"}',
  '"total attendees for cleanup exercises" -> {"type":"aggregation","operation":"sum","metric":"attendees","groupBy":"activity_type","filters":[{"field":"activity_type","value":"Cleanup Exercises"}],"mathRequired":true,"sheet":"Greening Initiative"}',
  '"which activity had the most attendees" -> {"type":"aggregation","operation":"rank","metric":"attendees","groupBy":"activity_type","order":"desc","limit":5,"mathRequired":true,"sheet":"Greening Initiative"}',
  
  // Resource queries (Greening Initiative)
  '"what resources are most lacking" -> {"type":"distribution","operation":"breakdown","metric":"resources_lacking","groupBy":null,"mathRequired":true,"sheet":"Greening Initiative"}',
  '"list all resources needed in Kasarani" -> {"type":"distribution","operation":"breakdown","metric":"resources_lacking","groupBy":"subcounty","filters":[{"field":"subcounty","value":"Kasarani"}],"mathRequired":true,"sheet":"Greening Initiative"}',
  
  // Cleanup queries (Greening Initiative)
  '"list all cleanup exercises" -> {"type":"distribution","operation":"breakdown","metric":"activity_type","groupBy":"activity_type","filters":[{"field":"activity_type","value":"Cleanup Exercises"}],"mathRequired":false,"sheet":"Greening Initiative"}',
  '"breakdown of activities by type" -> {"type":"distribution","operation":"breakdown","metric":"activity_type","groupBy":"activity_type","mathRequired":false,"sheet":"Greening Initiative"}',
  
  // Activity count queries (Greening Initiative)
  '"how many activities in Dandora" -> {"type":"aggregation","operation":"count","metric":"reports","groupBy":"ward","filters":[{"field":"ward","value":"Dandora"}],"mathRequired":true,"sheet":"Greening Initiative"}',
  
  // ===== Sensitization Programme Sheet Examples =====
  '"sensitization activities" -> {"type":"lookup","operation":"list","metric":"reports","filters":[{"field":"activity_type","value":"Community Sensitizations"}],"mathRequired":false,"sheet":"Sensitization Programme"}',
  '"show me Sensitization Programme data" -> {"type":"lookup","operation":"list","metric":"reports","sheet":"Sensitization Programme","mathRequired":false,"sheet":"Sensitization Programme"}',
  '"how many sensitization activities" -> {"type":"aggregation","operation":"count","metric":"reports","sheet":"Sensitization Programme","mathRequired":true,"sheet":"Sensitization Programme"}',
  '"sensitization in Mathare" -> {"type":"lookup","operation":"list","metric":"reports","filters":[{"field":"subcounty","value":"Mathare"}],"mathRequired":false,"sheet":"Sensitization Programme"}',
  '"key messages from sensitization" -> {"type":"distribution","operation":"breakdown","metric":"key_messages","mathRequired":false,"sheet":"Sensitization Programme"}',
  '"who partnered in sensitization" -> {"type":"distribution","operation":"breakdown","metric":"partners","mathRequired":false,"sheet":"Sensitization Programme"}',
  '"public baraza activities" -> {"type":"lookup","operation":"list","metric":"reports","filters":[{"field":"activity_type","value":"Public Baraza"}],"mathRequired":false,"sheet":"Sensitization Programme"}',
  
  // General queries (automatic sheet detection)
  '"activities this month" -> {"type":"lookup","operation":"list","metric":"reports","period":"this_month","mathRequired":false,"sheet":"Greening Initiative"}',
  '"activities in February 2026" -> {"type":"lookup","operation":"list","metric":"reports","dateFrom":"2026-02-01","dateTo":"2026-02-28","mathRequired":false,"sheet":"Greening Initiative"}',
  
  // Partner queries
  '"which organizations partnered in Mathare" -> {"type":"distribution","operation":"breakdown","metric":"partners","groupBy":"subcounty","filters":[{"field":"subcounty","value":"Mathare"}],"mathRequired":false,"sheet":"Greening Initiative"}',
  
  // Outcomes and outputs
  '"what were the outputs of cleanup activities" -> {"type":"distribution","operation":"breakdown","metric":"outputs","groupBy":null,"mathRequired":false,"sheet":"Greening Initiative"}',
  '"outcomes of activities in Mathare" -> {"type":"distribution","operation":"breakdown","metric":"outcomes","groupBy":"subcounty","filters":[{"field":"subcounty","value":"Mathare"}],"mathRequired":false,"sheet":"Greening Initiative"}'
].join('\n');

const system = [
  "You are the query-interpretation stage of an executive analytics chatbot for Nairobi's Green & Clean program.",
  "You have access to TWO Google Sheets: 'Greening Initiative' and 'Sensitization Programme'.",
  "Map the user's plain-language question onto ONE metric and (optionally) a dimension from the catalog, then classify it.",
  "Output ONLY minified JSON. No prose, no markdown fences.",
  "",
  "CATALOG:", CATALOG, "",
  "SCHEMA: {\"type\":\"lookup|aggregation|comparison|trend|distribution|ratio|rate\",\"operation\":\"rank|sum|avg|count|min|max|breakdown|rate|ratio|trend|difference|list\",\"metric\":\"<catalog metric or reports>\",\"secondaryMetric\":\"<numeric metric or null>\",\"groupBy\":\"<dimension or null>\",\"filters\":[{\"field\":\"<dimension>\",\"value\":\"<text>\"}],\"period\":\"today|yesterday|this_week|last_week|this_month|last_month|last_7_days|last_30_days|last_90_days|this_quarter|last_quarter|this_year|last_year|ytd|all|null\",\"dateFrom\":\"YYYY-MM-DD|null\",\"dateTo\":\"YYYY-MM-DD|null\",\"granularity\":\"day|week|month|null\",\"order\":\"desc|asc\",\"limit\":10,\"mathRequired\":true,\"sheet\":\"Greening Initiative|Sensitization Programme\"}",
  "",
  "SHEET SELECTION RULES (MOST IMPORTANT):",
  "1. If user mentions 'public sensitization', 'sensitization activities', 'sensitize', 'awareness', 'public baraza' -> sheet: 'Sensitization Programme'",
  "2. If user mentions 'tree', 'planting', 'greening', 'cleanup', 'clean up', 'staff', 'resources', 'deployed' -> sheet: 'Greening Initiative'",
  "3. If user doesn't specify, default to 'Greening Initiative'",
  "",
  "METRIC MAPPING:",
  "- 'staff' or 'deployed' or 'personnel' -> staff_deployed",
  "- 'attend' or 'people' or 'participants' -> attendees", 
  "- 'resource' or 'need' or 'lack' -> resources_lacking",
  "- 'partner' or 'organization' or 'collaborate' -> partners",
  "- 'message' or 'key message' or 'sensitize' -> key_messages",
  "- 'output' or 'result' or 'achieve' -> outputs",
  "- 'outcome' or 'impact' or 'effect' -> outcomes",
  "- 'activity' or 'exercise' or 'sensitization' or 'cleanup' or 'baraza' -> reports",
  "- 'tree' or 'plant' or 'greening' -> trees_planted",
  "- 'type' or 'species' -> tree_type",
  "",
  "RULES:",
  "1. mathRequired=true unless it is a pure single-record lookup/list.",
  "2. metric defaults to reports if counting activities, staff_deployed for staff questions, attendees for attendance questions.",
  "3. Put every named place/category into filters (field = the matching dimension).",
  "4. For time: if the user mentions a month (e.g., 'February 2026'), set dateFrom/dateTo explicitly. For relative time, set the period token.",
  "5. TIME: today is " + today + ". For a RELATIVE time phrase (last month, this week, past 30 days...) set \"period\" to the matching token. For explicit month/year, set dateFrom/dateTo.",
  "6. SHEET SELECTION: If the user says 'Public Sensitization', 'Sensitization Programme', use sheet: 'Sensitization Programme'. Otherwise use sheet: 'Greening Initiative'.",
  "",
  "EXAMPLES:", EXAMPLES
].join('\n');

const userMsg = (historyText ? ('Conversation so far:\n' + historyText + '\n\n') : '') + 'New question: ' + d.question;

const interpBody = {
  model: d.config.interpModel,
  max_tokens: d.config.maxTokensInterp,
  temperature: 0,
  system,
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: userMsg }]
};

return [{ json: Object.assign({}, d, { interpBody }) }];

parameters.content:
## Green & Clean Nairobi — Executive RAG Chatbot (Anthropic + n8n)

**Setup (3 credentials + 1 ID):**
1. **Anthropic** — *Header Auth* credential named `Anthropic API`; header **Name** `x-api-key`, **Value** your `sk-ant-...` key. Attach to nodes 3 & 10.
2. **Postgres** — attach to `5a`; edit the table name if not `green_clean_reports`.
3. **Google Sheets** — attach OAuth2 to `5b`; set the **documentId** to your Sheet ID.

Open the **Chat** tab and ask anything in the catalog below.

### Models (edit in `1. Init & Load Memory`)
Interpretation: `claude-haiku-4-5` · Synthesis: `claude-sonnet-4-6`.
If you switch synthesis to `claude-sonnet-5`, remove the `temperature` line in `9. Build Synthesis Request`.

### What it can now answer (any column)
**Metrics:** waste loads, loads remaining, staff, attendees, trees, seedlings, bins (total/emptied), trucks, arrests, report counts.
**Rates:** collection completion, data-quality confirmation, photo-evidence completeness, night surveillance, arrests.
**Ratios:** bins emptied ÷ total, loads remaining ÷ collected.
**Breakdowns:** by subcounty, ward, month, activity, incident type, vehicle, who collects (NCCG/contractor/CBO), tree type, sensitization type, flood severity/cause, drainage status, obstruction type/ownership, partners, most-lacking resources.
**Ops:** rank, sum, avg, min/max, trend, compare, distribution.
**Time:** understands 'last month', 'this week', 'past 30 days', 'March 2026', '3rd March', or a date range — resolved against today, then filtered.

_Try:_ "Which subcounty collected the most waste?" · "Breakdown of incidents by type" · "What share of collections were completed?" · "Who collects more, NCCG or contractors?" · "Which resources are most lacking?" · "Trees planted trend" · "Flooding by severity".

### Dual-source + automatic fallback
Both sources run with *Continue on Error*. `6. Resolve` uses whichever returned data; if both do, it follows `config.sourcePreference`.

⚠️ If Postgres and the Sheet hold the **same** records, set `sourcePreference` to `postgres` or `googlesheets` (not `merge`) to avoid double counting.

### Math firewall + validator
`7. Math Engine` does ALL arithmetic in JS across the full metric registry and tags it `pre_computed`. The LLM only writes prose from those ground-truth numbers. `11. Validate` re-checks the headline figure (`math.primary`) and corrects drift.
